content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I direct that all my personal property, including but not limited to jewelry, artwork, and collectibles, shall be distributed equally among my children, Sarah Hartley and Michael Hartley.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I give and bequeath my residence located at 123 Elm Street, Pineville City, to my spouse, Robert Hartley, for his lifetime, and upon his death, it shall pass to my children, Sarah Hartley and Michael Hartley, in equal shares.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Funeral_Arrangements
content_blocks.text: I request that my funeral be conducted in accordance with the wishes set forth in my personal papers, and that my ashes be interred at Green Hill Cemetery, Pineville City.
